# Markitdown Server

Source: https://github.com/demomacro/markitdown-server/blob/master/README.md

# Markitdown Server

![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/github/license/DemoMacro/markitdown-server)

> A HTTP server for markitdown, providing RESTful API service for document to Markdown conversion.

## Overview

Markitdown Server is a lightweight, containerized service that leverages Microsoft's MarkItDown library to convert various document formats into Markdown.

## Requirements

- Node.js >= 18.0.0
- Docker Engine
- pnpm (recommended) or npm/yarn
- Docker image containing markitdown (configured via environment)

## Installation

```bash
# Clone the repository
$ git clone https://github.com/DemoMacro/markitdown-server.git
$ cd markitdown-server

# Install dependencies
$ pnpm install

# Setup environment
$ cp .env.example .env
```

## Usage

### Development

```bash
# Start development server
$ pnpm dev

# Server starts at http://localhost:3000
```

### Production

```bash
# Build for production
$ pnpm build

# Start production server
$ pnpm start

# Stop production server
$ pnpm stop
```

### API Usage

```typescript
// Using fetch API
const response = await fetch("http://localhost:3000/api/convert", {
  method: "POST",
  body: formData, // multipart/form-data with file
});

const markdown = await response.text();
console.log(markdown);
```

```bash
# Using curl
curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/convert \
  -F "file=@document.pdf"
```

## Configuration

### Environment Variables

```bash
# Docker image configuration (required)
NITRO_DOCKER_IMAGE="your-docker-registry/markitdown:latest"
```
